claims.claim_text: Teal Drones was selected by DoD's Defense Innovation Unit and U.S. Army to compete in the Short Range Reconnaissance Tranche 2 (SRR T2) Program of Record and was awarded a $1.5M prototype contract; Teal will compete for the SRR T2 production contract.
claims.subject: Teal Drones (Red Cat subsidiary)
claims.source_quote: In March 2022, Teal was selected by the Department of Defense's (DoD) Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) and U.S. Army to compete in the Short Range Reconnaissance Tranche 2 (SRR T2) Program of Record... Teal was notified by the U.S. Army's Short Range Reconnaissance Product Office that it would advance to the prototype phase of the SRR T2 program and was awarded a $1.5M prototype contract. Teal will develop a next-generation drone that meets or exceeds the Army's technical system requirements of SRR T2 and competes for the SRR T2 production contract.

claims.claim_text: Teal's Golden Eagle was selected for the SRR Tranche 1 program (began 2020) with a prototype contract and is one of five Blue sUAS list-approved drones authorized by DoD.
claims.subject: Teal Drones Golden Eagle
claims.source_quote: The SRR Tranche 1 program began in 2020, and Teal was similarly selected for that program with a prototype contract award as part of its selection. The five drones (including Teal's Golden Eagle) developed for SRR Tranche 1 became the five drones named to the Blue sUAS list in August 2020 and were subsequently approved by the Department of Defense (DoD) and other U.S. Federal Departments.

claims.claim_text: Teal anchors the Enterprise Segment and is expected to drive the segment's revenues in fiscal 2023 and beyond; Red Cat expects government customers including defense, public safety, and infrastructure to be its most significant revenue drivers in the fiscal year ending April 30, 2023.
claims.subject: Red Cat Holdings
claims.source_quote: Teal anchors the Enterprise Segment and is expected to drive the segment's revenues in fiscal 2023 and beyond... we expect government customers including defense, public safety, and infrastructure to be our most significant revenue drivers in the fiscal year ending April 30, 2023.

claims.claim_text: In December 2021, Teal Drones was one of only five contractors awarded a firm, fixed-price multiple-award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) by U.S. Customs and Border Protection with an estimated value of $90 million over a 5-year ordering period for DHS UAS procurement.
claims.subject: Teal Drones
claims.object_value: CBP BPA up to $90M over 5 years
claims.source_quote: Awarded Customs and Border Protection Contract Worth up to $90 Million over Five Years In December 2021, Teal Drones was one of only five contractors awarded a firm, fixed price, multiple award blanket purchase agreement (BPA) by the United States Customs and Border Protection. The BPA has an estimated value of $90 million in total over a 5-year ordering period.

claims.claim_text: In April 2022, Teal secured an order for 15 Golden Eagle drone units from a NATO Member Country for deployment in Ukraine.
claims.subject: Teal Drones
claims.object_value: 15 Golden Eagle units to NATO member for Ukraine
claims.source_quote: Purchase Order for Golden Eagle Drone Units from NATO Member Country for Deployment in Ukraine In April 2022, Teal secured an order for 15 Golden Eagle drone units...

claims.claim_text: In September 2021, Skypersonic was awarded a five-year contract with NASA to provide drone and rover software, hardware and support for NASA's Simulated Mars mission.
claims.subject: Skypersonic (Red Cat subsidiary)
claims.object_value: NASA Simulated Mars mission five-year contract
claims.source_quote: Awarded NASA Contract In September 2021, Skypersonic was awarded a five-year contract with NASA to provide drone and rover software, hardware and support for NASA's Simulated Mars mission.

claims.claim_text: Teal moved to a new 13,000+ square foot manufacturing facility in Salt Lake City, Utah in October 2021 and doubled the size of the facility in January 2022 to scale production capacity for forecasted SRR/Blue sUAS demand.
claims.subject: Teal Drones
claims.object_value: Salt Lake City, UT manufacturing facility (~26,000 sqft post-expansion)
claims.source_quote: Teal opens new manufacturing facility located in Salt Lake City, Utah. In October 2021, Teal moved to a new 13,000+ square foot facility... In January 2022, Teal doubled the size of its facility in order to fully scale production capacity to meet the forecasted growth in demand.

claims.claim_text: Red Cat has executed an acquisition-driven rollup strategy: Fat Shark ($8.4M, Nov 2020), Rotor Riot ($2.0M), Skypersonic ($2.8M, May 2021), and Teal Drones ($10.0M, Aug 2021); the rollup is funded by $76M+ of common stock raises in 2021.
claims.subject: Red Cat Holdings
claims.object_value: Four acquisitions in <2 years; rollup financed by ~$76M equity issuance
claims.source_quote: In November 2020, the Company acquired Fat Shark Holdings... total purchase price was $8.4 million. In May 2021, we acquired Skypersonic... total purchase price was $2.8 million. In August 2021, we closed the acquisition of Teal Drones... total purchase price was $10.0 million. In May 2021, we completed an offering of common stock which raised gross proceeds of $16 million. In July 2021, we completed an offering of common stock which raised gross proceeds of $60 million.
